notes: אִישׁ וְאִישׁ: the ASV writes a word for each occurrence and a connective for the waw, so rule 22's distributive-repetition fusion does not arise; the contrastive 'This'/'that' join each noun's unit under rule 15, headed on 'one'.
Explicit הוּא takes 'himself' beside the written subject עֶלְיוֹן; 'the Most High' is one unit on the anarthrous substantival adjective, headed on 'High' with 'Most' the named competitor.
